book.name: Genesis
book.title: Genesis Mosesna Moamba Memba, Indhanana Pholmomba.

content: Yakopva Hevna Eunilmom Ishunvna Hevna Ombtowondalm 12pelaram.
Doa Yakop ona, otomotalva kanaoa prapiara. Doa ambanamba, hev unna, hui murapeta kusoo, yemba kava isholm vinv, si mana vemamba yemba phunvav.
Doa unna, yimba katindi Yakoptindi, wo kava eva Israel.

Rupen, mekava yemba ishomnav, yimba kana yiveltowond, wo kava yenanapopol lohv. Nemetva kangas tendoriniva lohvna, yemba kava wailohmana vevna. Wo yimba kelsombovhol lohv, wo boaslapevmba yimba kuvhoawol vev andramba.

Wo heva os yimba pueumbmsna lohv, mana vemamba yimba wohpilingavav. Yimba yiveltowond lohv, heva os owai, yimba kuwulva mendekliva wulluhunvavmoa, manara, yimba sahonam vena, yimba kana vuhera sihanamba, kana andranind unguvlirinim Bilham wailina.
Simeon, Levi yimba ehellevm, yimba etel boaslal elohv, indhanamba yimba bunevalgona welhowol evev.

Doa yimba ekithohovpa, di ihishov, indhanam helvawolalm. Kava owai vev, manam kava hellevav, yemongova kava anongla vevavmoa. Nemetva yimba daosm ohovna, indhanam ewuleihavna, wo ungundna sapiaralm ambo muerialm tengamol koaksa evevna.

Tandmomba yenamba esvema luhunvna, kava ovov, memba sahoklal. Tandmomba yenamba indhanam endesvotvna, kin plothunvna. Yetindiva si mongawulmba aevulvavmoa, owai, ka si wolanga vuku vevav, dom hovram ten katindi Israeltindi aevluwul vevm. Wo di hovra himba aevluwul vevra nohalm nohalm.
Yuta yeoa hellevm, owapevpa si yem wivivav, manara, yimba ungundmba omoval kakaiv velohv. Etepevpa si kuva kusithapramnavav yemba.
Yimba os sungeitwindena nihna, oi laion. Himba hevna tatamba wena vevna, wo henga hevna vuheram gavna. Doa di himba indund lithavna, englamongla shuawol vevna, an eva ata gavta kevralmba hemba, owai.

Yimba si kuwul mendekli wulluhunvav, wo simbepolva yenamba si osangas wulvahinvav. Verava, hona indhanarini si lohvav kuwulalmba, Silo. Monglava indhanamba si woh iambmanavav yemba, hevna kuva kusithapramnavav.
Yimba si donkina meisra gavav, doa holoperava, donkimba wena ningevav. Denwitmingra ningevav, nomba denwitva besalangas, wainpolva nominiva besvev os i.
Wo yimba mindnam nevav, novnihilva yenamba aembul lovahvav. Wo lomba yenamba dombal elohvav, manara, sapina tetpolva yimba elsus nelohvav.
Sepulun yeoa hellevm, yimba si di wanda aevulvav, wo sipva si ambvrava yeindam, dom angavra wohnahonam. Pethava yenamba garava, doa Siton kembella.
Isakar yeoa hellevm, yimba kinnindrini ambo, oi donki. Yimba pevna kinsingi si lohmana vevav,
heva os yimba si nonglavav, pai memba besal kuksa vekohal lohv, memba pethava besal luhuku vev. Doa henga yimba gavav, kinda vithavav, os gavav, yimba si os lohmana vevav, oi andranindrini indhanana.
Dan yeoa hellevm. Yimba si kuwul wulluhunvav pevtindim. Wo himba si os aevulvra, oi katindi Israeltindi.

Wo yimba os av, oi saihola monapethalla hethilohv, saipusuhla. Wo indhanarini hossra prorava, yimba lelnam nungi lovav hosna munngulmba. Wo hosva ata pemba vilivhoarava, wo aralmba wupianga meisis pethara.
Doa Yakopva mendah ishongeinvna, ona Yawe, kava yem amnav, kam kolvro.
Gat yeoa hellevm, indhanamba si yemba monarava kevrirava, yemba helvakomandhirava, wo diva wohva hevm nomba dumbra. Wo owai, yimba si engilguavav hemba.
Aser yeoa hellevm, osonnamba yenamba si bes vevav os i. Indhanamba si lihvav, wo uvav, honamba lehra dihelv kuwulilmba.
Naptali yeoa hellevm, yimba meme nenmalmsna lohv. Pevelm ambo lohmana vev. Yimba otolva besalangas towand velohv.
Yosep yeoa hellevm, yimba wainweselmsna endv pora, wo klalva hoanwonam lelga vev, pueilmba ningev, wo wainmovpa mindnam kethav.
Ungundva yenamba yemba engvilangav bunevalgona,

heva os yimba kuvund vrevmoa, yimba indundangas pviav, wo englava yenamba keknam elohv. Manara, Sesoa hev yemba poauothov, Sesoa mendekli. Himba pimba Israelnindmba os poauothowol vev, oi tendorini mi gav, sipsipm wongav, kekalvho vrungeinv.

Tanam Sesoava kana mendekli lohv, hev yemba si poauothovav, wo kolvrevav. Manara, himba keknamangas wohlohv. Himba pom wolaihaprinvna senaminiva eva pethariniva, temba novolva livpa. Yetindina ongahmunilva si tetwond vevav mindnam.

Sesoa yemoa mindnam awothora, wo eva dembrahora manimani olorini besal doaramini. Kava Sesoam nengmanav, manam himba aivovo vevav, men honamba kava daipotava ov. Sesoaoa yena kura engla holothora, ovra, Yosepm men kava mindnam nengmanav. Henamba etehumunilmba memba espetambo kava ninginv.
Bensamin yeoa hellevm, yimba sungeitwindenonoa. Yimba simolnam eunumbolohv tatamba. Wo simba yimba mendah eunumbolohvna.
Doa memba Israelna ombol 12pelara lovahna, wo hona moamba he ishuwul vinvna, nonamba eunillam hev ishunnam. Hev vena, awothowol vena, ishunna, yimba honamba si os lohvav, yimba honamba si os lohvav.
Yakopm Dahana.
Doa Yakop henga unna, kamba dahav. Wo yeoa kamindmoa di singviu Kenan pethara.

Honmera singviu, di ten sahal lohvm. Nomba sahalva Evron seilva vaohothonamba, wo Aprahamba kovorahona, wo diva hev dombna. Evronmba nomba Hitnindrini lohna. Sahalva nomba os ningthivna Makpela, wo di lohv Mamrera nohalm, ten okomba pholohvm. Aprahamba doara di singvina eva ongalm Saram. Isakmba di singvinamba eva ongalm Repekam. Dita kava singvena kavna ongamba Leamba.
Doa ishopianamba, lithanamba, os wohdahana.
